description: Controlled catalog for the stable 报告风险 identity (docs/risk-identity-contract.md). 风险键 = <类型码>|<风险对象>|<风险规则ID>. Types and rule IDs exist only here; a writer never derives a rule ID from a description, a threshold reading or a date. A rule ID keeps its meaning forever: rewording a definition or adjusting a threshold keeps the ID, a materially different rule gets a new ID and a recorded migration. Rules restate risk checks the Prompt Suite already names (prompts/portfolio-health-check.md sections 3-5 and 7, the five 风险类型 of the Daily/Weekly prompts); the catalog adds no investment principle.

object_scopes.security: One canonical 代码 of this generation's 报告持仓 (never a name, never an 影响资产 list, never PORTFOLIO).
object_scopes.any: Either a canonical 代码 of this generation's 报告持仓 or PORTFOLIO.

rules.title: 投资假设漂移
rules.definition: 当前事实不再支持原始投资假设，或持有理由已偏离原始理由。

rules.title: 企业质量削弱
rules.definition: 企业质量、竞争优势、管理层或资本配置出现削弱的事实。

rules.title: 现金流与成长假设削弱
rules.definition: 自由现金流或长期成长假设受到削弱。

rules.title: 估值压缩长期回报
rules.definition: 估值已改变长期回报空间。

rules.title: 持仓集中度
rules.definition: 最大持仓或前几大持仓超过理解边界。
rules.source: prompts/portfolio-health-check.md §3 组合结构审计（集中度）

rules.title: 重复暴露
rules.definition: 不同持仓本质上依赖同一产业、主题或风险来源。
rules.source: prompts/portfolio-health-check.md §3 组合结构审计（行业/主题/重复暴露）

rules.title: 地区与货币暴露
rules.definition: 单一地区或汇率变化可能放大组合波动。
rules.source: prompts/portfolio-health-check.md §3 组合结构审计（地区/货币暴露）

rules.title: 现金选择权
rules.definition: 现金不足以提供必要选择权。
rules.source: prompts/portfolio-health-check.md §3 组合结构审计（现金）

rules.title: 行为偏离系统
rules.definition: 出现行为风险信号：因短期涨跌改变判断、因现金或新 NISA 额度急于行动、因错过机会降低标准、把持仓惯性误认为长期信念。

rules.title: 系统环境
rules.definition: 市场环境、利率、汇率、监管或地缘等系统因素影响长期假设。
rules.source: prompts/portfolio-health-check.md §5 风险集中审计（系统风险）

migration: risk-catalog-v1 carries no legacy-key mapping: a pre-#375 报告风险 identity (风险类型 + 风险 free text) cannot be mapped to a 风险键 without real risk texts and codes, which never enter this public repository. A comparison against a pre-#375 generation is therefore a 迁移缺口 (docs/risk-identity-contract.md 'Migration').
